name: 2027 Teacher Planner

listing.title: 2027 Teacher Planner for Classroom Teachers - Printable Monthly Calendar
listing.description:
A dated 2027 planner for classroom teachers.

Inside: a cover, a How to use page, a 2027 year-at-a-glance page and 12 monthly calendar pages (January to December 2027, weeks start on Sunday). Every month page has This month's focus, Key dates and Notes boxes. Two extra pages: a Class Roster page and a Term Overview page.

Print it on A4 or US Letter paper.

instructions: Print the A4 or US Letter file at 100% (actual size).
Write term dates and parents' evenings in Key dates.
Keep the Class Roster page at the front of your folder.
